column3: The Hebrew uses “give My covenant” rather than “establish My covenant.”
The Hebrew explicitly includes “throughout their generations.”
The Hebrew repeats “after you” following “your descendants.”
The Hebrew explicitly says “purchased with your money”; BSB shortens this to “purchased.”
The Hebrew explicitly specifies “the flesh of his foreskin” and calls the person “that soul.”
The Hebrew says “she will become nations”; BSB supplies “the mother of.”
“In his heart” is rendered as “to himself.”
The Hebrew says “live before You” where BSB has “live under Your blessing.”
The Hebrew says “I have blessed him” where BSB has “I will surely bless him.”
The Hebrew explicitly says he circumcised “the flesh of their foreskin.”
The Hebrew explicitly mentions “the flesh of his foreskin.”
The Hebrew repeats that Ishmael was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
